content.job_description: Develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js.Design and implement RESTful APIs and help evolve our microservices architecture.Translate business and customer needs into reliable, high-performance applications.Collaborate closely with a small, agile team through scrum rituals, prototyping, and code reviews.Contribute to the overall architecture, scalability, and quality of our backend systems.
content.job_requirement: 4+ years of professional experience working with Node.js (ES6).Intermediate English communication skills — you're willing to grow with us.Understanding of microservices and distributed systems.Solid understanding of RESTful API design and backend architecture.Experienced with Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, and PostgreSQL.Familiar with unit testing frameworks like Jest or Mocha, and passionate about code quality.Able to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.Comfortable working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.[Nice to have]Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., S3, ECS, Lambda).Familiarity with message queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS).Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS).Familiar with authentication/authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth2, JWT).
content.job_benefit: Compensation & BenefitsFull social insurance coverage and premium healthcare benefits.Competitive salary with 13th-month pay and performance bonus.Paid leave — vacation, sick leave, and maternity leave.Build Your Career with ImpactBe part of a mission-driven company that's transforming human potential.Empower over 200,000+ coaches in more than 200 countries — including Olympic athletes, military trainers, rehab specialists, and celebrity coaches.Make a global impact while building a meaningful, purpose-driven career.Continuous training and mentoring.1–2 performance reviews annually.Work EnvironmentEnglish-speaking, international environment promoting open communication and collaboration.Work alongside world-class talent from companies like Apple, Meta, Uber, Patreon, and Nike, united by a shared passion for impact and excellence.International team for global career growth.State-of-the-art equipment provided.Beautiful working environment near Danang's city center (Dragon Bridge) and Hanoi office.Health & WellnessPVI health insurance program and annual health check-ups.Active sports clubs (football, badminton, pickleball) and company retreats.A modern pantry designed for relaxation and social connection.Monthly wellness and learning workshops to recharge and grow.
